messages:
Jordan: kicking off RC creation for candidate 2026-03-21. artifact sha256:af9b33c2... attaching release-note draft.
Anya: acked, can you paste the final changelog snippet? small db migration noted.
Mike: i double-checked the migration — it's a noop unless feature flag enabled. good to proceed from infra side :thumbsup:
Jordan: copy. plan: origination -> kv-warm -> canary (5%) -> promote. Pinning artifact to avoid late-change drift.
QA: quick smoke passed on staging, flagged one flaky test (response-time) — skippable for now but will monitor.
Jordan: recorded migration steps in the release notes. pinning tag: rc-20260321-01 -> artifact:sha256:af9b33c2
Jordan: @deploy-bot please schedule canary for 09:10 UTC in the next window and set TTL 20m.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary start=2026-03-21T09:10:00Z window=20m target=5% artifact=sha256:af9b33c2 (id: dpl-8891)
Anya: adding a rollback plan here: rollback = promote previous stable (artifact:sha256:7c2d...). If OOM or error-rate>2% for 3m, abort and rollback.
SRE-Bot: telemetry alarms created: error_rate, p95_latency, kv_miss_ratio. thresholds set. slack-alerts @sre-team
Mike: KV warm note — warm keys script will run during canary start, should reduce cold-start spike.
Jordan: starting origination now. leaving a manual hold for canary kick until QA final signoff.
deploy-bot: Origination complete. artifacts pinned. canary is READY but HOLD by user.
QA: done with the final eyeball. no new blockers. you have QA signoff from me.
Jordan: ok releasing hold and kicking canary.
Anya: if anything weird, we flip traffic back to dedicated pool and pin old artifact. keeping eyes on logs.
deploy-bot: Canary began 2026-03-21T09:10:12Z (5% traffic). dpl-8891. Monitoring metrics...
deploy-bot: Canary metric snapshot (3m): error_rate=0.1% p95=120ms kv_miss=0.6% — all green.
Mike: looks stable. proceeding with staged ramp to 20% over 10m per plan.
SRE-Bot: alert: p95_latency breached 400ms on a subset of requests (region: eu-west). severity=warn.
Jordan: throttling ramp, holding at 10%. Anya, can you check infra in eu-west?
Anya: digging into host swap logs, rolling a small config tweak (kernel flag). will apply to canary hosts.
deploy-bot: Applied config tweak to canary hosts in eu-west. continuing ramp when green.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp resumed. snapshot (10m): error_rate=0.15% p95=130ms — stable.
Jordan: given green, promoting to prod. final promotion command:
```
/deploy promote --rc=rc-20260321-01 --to=prod --pin=artifact:sha256:af9b33c2 --reason="rc-promote-stable" 
```
deploy-bot: Promotion accepted. starting phased rollout to prod (15m rollout, rollback window 10m). id: dpl-8891-prom
SRE-Bot: Watching telemetry. standby channel #eng-oncall
Jordan: thank you team. release notes published to docs/release-notes/2026-03-21.md and ticket updated.
QA: will follow up with regression smoke after 30m. please ping if anything odd.
Mike: post-mortem checklist prepped in case of rollback.
Jordan: closing this thread once prod finish metrics green. :tada:
